description: This Java class implements the DefaultDeletionConfig, a specific configuration class for deletion settings within the Eclipse Ditto services. It handles configuration parameters such as enabling delete operations, defining deletion age, interval timing, and the first interval hour, with validation and factory methods.

classes.name: DefaultDeletionConfig
classes.description: Implements the DeletionConfig interface, providing configuration parameters for deletion operations, including enabling flag, deletion age, run interval, and first interval hour with validation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultDeletionConfig from a given Config object, loading and validating the deletion configuration values.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the deletion feature is enabled.

methods.name: getDeletionAge
methods.description: Returns the duration defining how old data must be before deletion.

methods.name: getRunInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval duration for deletion runs.

methods.name: getFirstIntervalHour
methods.description: Returns the hour of the day when the first deletion interval occurs.
